idasuri.title: Use Unique ID For URI
idasuri.remarks: If the check box is selected, the unique ID value is used as the resource URI.

oslcnsuri.title: Namespace URI
oslcnsuri.remarks: When populated, this value is the namespace for the resource. The namespaces are used for common resources that are not associated with any OSLC domain.

oslcname.title: OSLC Resource Name
oslcname.remarks: The name of the OSLC resource.

domainname.title: Domain Name
domainname.remarks: The OSLC domain to which the resource belongs.

oslcsearchattrs.title: Searchable Attributes
oslcsearchattrs.remarks: A comma-separated list of columns from the primary object of the resource that are defined as text searchable. This list of columns are available for OSLC text search.

oslcusageuri.title: OSLC Usage URI
oslcusageuri.remarks: An identifier URI for the domain that specified the usage of the resource.

intobjectname.title: Object Structure
intobjectname.remarks: Identifies the object structure to which the OSLC resource belongs. This value must be unique and the object structure can be tied only to one resource.

dfltpagesize.title: Default Page Size
dfltpagesize.remarks: When you query a resource collection, the page size determines the number of member resources that are returned on each page.

defaultusage.title: Is Default Usage
defaultusage.remarks: Identifies the object structure as the default object structure for this resource.

etagupdatecol.title: ETag Update Attribute
etagupdatecol.remarks: The column of the primary object for the resource that is updated when a child object modification does not update the primary object. The child object is defined as a local resource.

dfltnsuri.title: Default Namespace URI
dfltnsuri.remarks: Any property that is not explicitly mapped to a namespace belongs to the default namespace.
